gripOrHq.title: Ice Pick Willie
gripOrHq.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Trash a program.
[Subroutine] End the run.

gripOrHq.title: Team Restructuring
gripOrHq.rulesText: Add one advancement counter to each of up to two installed cards that can be advanced.

gripOrHq.title: Canis Minor
gripOrHq.rulesText: [Subroutine] For the remainder of the run, all further ice is encountered at +1 strength.

gripOrHq.title: Employee Empowerment
gripOrHq.rulesText: You may choose to draw an additional card at the start of each of your turns. [A]: Draw two cards.

gripOrHq.title: Systematic Layoffs
gripOrHq.rulesText: Add two advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

heapOrArchives.title: Bizarre Encryption Scheme
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Bizarre Encryption Scheme may only be installed in a subsidiary data fort. Runner does not score any agenda (or agendas) that he or she accesses from this fort; return the agenda to the fort instead. Runner scores the agenda at the start of his or her next turn if it is still in the fort.

discardCards.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
discardCards.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

discardCards.title: Chiba Bank Account
discardCards.rulesText: [1], [T]: Gain [4]. You may use this ability whenever you pay any cost or penalty. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

discardCards.title: Rent-I-Con
discardCards.rulesText: [1]: Break ice subroutine. At the end of this run, trash Rent-I-Con. [1]: +1 strength

ice.rulesText:

[Subroutine] The Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during this run.
